subject: Life Skills
title: Bias in Search Results
description: A fast breakdown of Bias in Search Results for builders.

hook.text: The first page of Google gets 95% of all clicks. Most people never see the second page.

buildup.text: Search engines rank by relevance and authority, but those metrics are shaped by popularity.

discovery.text: SEO means websites optimize for algorithms, not for truth. Top results are the best marketed.

twist.text: Your past searches personalize results. Two people searching the same phrase may see different answers.

climax.text: Use incognito mode for research. Try multiple search engines to compare what surfaces.

punchline.text: Top of the page means popular, not correct.

quiz.question: Why might two people see different results for the same search?
options: Search engines personalize results based on history
One person has a newer browser
